definitions.explanation: The number twenty. Formed by combining {二|に} (two) and {十|じゅう} (ten), literally meaning 'two tens.'

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{二十|にじゅう}{歳|さい}からお{酒|さけ}が{飲|の}めます。
examples.english: In Japan, you can drink alcohol from twenty years old.

examples.japanese: {二十|にじゅう}{分|ぷん}ぐらいかかります。
{二十|はたち}の{誕生日|たんじょうび}おめでとう。
examples.notes: Special reading はたち for age 20

notes: Twenty has a special reading {二十|はたち} specifically when referring to age (turning 20). This is because 20 is traditionally the age of adulthood in Japan. In other contexts, {二十|にじゅう} is used. The Japanese number system is very regular: tens are formed by [number] + {十|じゅう}.
